The 50/50 split (one part vinegar, one part water) is the baseline for
refrigerator pickles. Vinegar strength matters more than the type: use
white vinegar at 5% acidity and the recipe is forgiving; drop to 4% and
keep the cucumbers whole or they soften.

Add salt to taste, not to preserve — these never ferment, they just sit
in the fridge. A tablespoon of sugar balances the acid.

Timing: three days for halves, a week for whole cucumbers. The brine
stays clear if the jar is not opened; once opened, it clouds but the
pickles are fine for weeks.
